subtasks.details: Setup react-i18next, create translation files for multiple languages, implement language switcher component, and ensure proper RTL support for applicable languages.

subtasks.title: Build Common UI Components Library
subtasks.description: Create reusable UI components like buttons, modals, tooltips, and loading states
subtasks.details: Develop component library with consistent styling, create Storybook documentation, implement accessibility features, and ensure keyboard navigation support.

subtasks.title: Implement Performance Optimizations
subtasks.description: Add code splitting, lazy loading, and memoization for optimal performance
subtasks.details: Setup React.lazy for route-based code splitting, implement React.memo for expensive components, add intersection observer for lazy loading images, and optimize bundle size.

tasks.title: Deploy and Monitor Production
tasks.description: Set up production deployment on VPS with monitoring and backup strategies
tasks.details:
Production deployment setup:
- Configure VPS (4 vCPU, 4GB RAM, Ubuntu 22.04)
- Set up Nginx reverse proxy with SSL (Let's Encrypt)
- Configure PostgreSQL with connection pooling (max 10 connections)
- Implement Redis caching (512MB)
- Set up monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana
- Configure automated backups (daily DB dumps, 7-day retention)
- Implement health checks and alerts
- Set up CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
- Configure firewall rules and security hardening
- Document deployment procedures and disaster recovery plan (4h RTO, 24h RPO)
tasks.testStrategy: Load test with 100 concurrent users, verify backup/restore procedures, test failover scenarios, ensure monitoring alerts work, validate SSL configuration, test API response times <200ms

subtasks.title: VPS Configuration
subtasks.description: Set up and configure the virtual private server with proper OS, networking, and base system requirements
subtasks.details: Install Ubuntu/Debian OS, configure hostname, timezone, swap space, update system packages, set up firewall (UFW), configure SSH with key-based authentication, disable root login, create deployment user with sudo privileges

subtasks.title: Nginx Setup
subtasks.description: Install and configure Nginx web server for reverse proxy and static file serving
subtasks.details: Install Nginx, configure server blocks for application domains, set up reverse proxy configuration, optimize Nginx performance settings, configure gzip compression, set up request rate limiting, configure logging and log rotation

subtasks.title: SSL Configuration
subtasks.description: Implement SSL/TLS certificates for secure HTTPS connections
subtasks.details: Install Certbot, generate Let's Encrypt SSL certificates for all domains, configure auto-renewal with cron jobs, implement SSL best practices (HSTS, OCSP stapling), configure SSL ciphers and protocols, set up HTTP to HTTPS redirects

subtasks.title: Database Setup
subtasks.description: Install and configure production database server with security and performance optimizations
subtasks.details: Install PostgreSQL/MySQL, create production database and users, configure connection pooling, set up database security (firewall rules, SSL connections), optimize database configuration for production workload, implement query logging and slow query monitoring

subtasks.title: Redis Configuration
subtasks.description: Set up Redis for caching and session management with persistence and security
subtasks.details: Install Redis server, configure Redis persistence (RDB snapshots and AOF), set up Redis authentication, configure maxmemory policies, implement Redis Sentinel for high availability, secure Redis with firewall rules and bind to localhost

subtasks.title: Monitoring Setup
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring stack for system metrics, logs, and alerts
subtasks.details: Install Prometheus and Grafana, configure node_exporter for system metrics, set up application metrics exporters, create Grafana dashboards, configure alerting rules for critical metrics, integrate with notification channels (email, Slack), set up log aggregation with ELK stack or Loki

subtasks.title: Backup Implementation
subtasks.description: Configure automated backup solutions for database, files, and system configurations
subtasks.details: Set up automated database backups with pg_dump/mysqldump, configure Redis backup scripts, implement file system backups for uploads and configurations, set up remote backup storage (S3, B2), create backup rotation policies, implement backup testing procedures

subtasks.title: CI/CD Pipeline
subtasks.description: Create continuous integration and deployment pipeline for automated deployments
subtasks.details: Set up GitHub Actions/GitLab CI configuration, create build and test stages, implement deployment scripts with zero-downtime deployments, configure environment-specific variables, set up Docker registry if using containers, implement rollback procedures

subtasks.title: Security Hardening
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive security measures and best practices
subtasks.details: Configure fail2ban for intrusion prevention, set up security headers in Nginx, implement CSP policies, configure SELinux/AppArmor, set up regular security updates with unattended-upgrades, implement audit logging, configure network segmentation

subtasks.title: Health Checks
subtasks.description: Implement application and infrastructure health monitoring endpoints
subtasks.details: Create application health check endpoints, configure Nginx health checks for upstream servers, set up database connection health monitoring, implement Redis health checks, create synthetic monitoring for critical user paths, configure uptime monitoring service

subtasks.title: Documentation
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation for deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting
subtasks.details: Document server architecture and network topology, create runbooks for common operations, document deployment procedures, write troubleshooting guides, create security incident response procedures, document backup and restore processes, maintain configuration inventory

subtasks.title: Disaster Recovery Procedures
subtasks.description: Establish and test disaster recovery plans and procedures
subtasks.details: Create disaster recovery plan document, implement automated restore scripts, test backup restoration procedures, set up monitoring for backup integrity, create RTO/RPO requirements documentation, implement failover procedures, conduct regular DR drills
